title: Do not pin production on latest / vendor aliases
purpose: Aliases move under you. Retired slugs may remap instead of 404.
trigger: Code uses latest, grok-latest, claude-3-haiku, grok-4-fast as a durable production pin.
correct: Pin a documented snapshot ID. Treat aliases as moving pointers. Test that the billed model matches the named model.
legacy_evidence_note: Eval tooling has reported xAI retired slugs remapping onto a newer slug at a different price.

provenance.claim: Rule preserved from v0.2; classification metadata added conservatively.
